intent_en: To highlight the limited proportion of arable land in Somalia relative to India and Germany.
previous_intent: To compare the proportion of arable land in Somalia with that of India and Germany.
narration_support: Only 1 .8 % of its land is arable, compared to half of India, or 34 % of Germany.
chart_support: Donut charts with flags of Somalia, India, and Germany illustrating the share of arable land.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly compares arable land percentages (1.8% vs half vs 34%), and the chart visualizes this with donut charts for Somalia (tiny blue segment), India (large green segment), and Germany (black segment).
